areas.title: Smart features, AI, audio, study & collaboration

exceptions.covers: Passwords (`lock.setup`), AI API keys, WebDAV and relay secrets, bridge enable/token/port/networks (`bridge.setEnabled`), confirmation policies and every `security.*` setting (read and write), plugin grants
exceptions.instead: Ask the user; open the settings page (`panel.open`, deep link)
exceptions.why: A caller must never widen its own permissions or read secrets

exceptions.covers: Commands that show system UI: camera and scan, document/folder pickers (`import.pick`, `library.chooseFolder`, `backup.chooseFolder`, `template.choose`), Face ID/password (`doc.unlock`, `doc.setLocked`), print and share sheets, microphone (`audio.record`)
exceptions.instead: Call them: the UI appears on the device and the user completes it (bridge requests wait up to 120 s)
exceptions.why: iOS requires a person at the system UI

exceptions.covers: Every command that touches a locked document; search, backup, WebDAV and collaboration skip them
exceptions.why: The password lock is an access gate

exceptions.instead: AI and bridge: call them, always confirmed. Plugins: not possible
exceptions.why: Plugins must not install or enable plugins

exceptions.instead: The user can expose them anyway (`security.plugins.exposeHiddenCommands`)

exceptions.covers: Every non-`read` command while "Create mode" is off, including nested calls and plugin handlers
exceptions.instead: Propose the change; the user switches to Edit mode
exceptions.why: The user asked for a read-only conversation

exceptions.covers: `irreversible` (empty trash, purge, delete audio, overwrite a source file), `sensitive` (WebDAV/backup destinations, collaboration, relay, microphone, calendar, Photos, AI provider endpoints) and `plugins:manage` commands
exceptions.instead: Call them; the user answers Allow / Allow for this turn / Deny
exceptions.why: Cannot be undone, or data leaves the device

items.note: Reflow works for any Vision-recognised language, not only English; cursive/rotated lines still reflow poorly.

Handwritten-math recognition uses the user's own vision-capable AI model; offline fallback handles simple arithmetic/algebra via Vision text recognition.
Detection via Vision + UITextChecker; corrections are synthesised ink matched to word size/slant/colour, not a personalised handwriting model.

why: CloudKit/iCloud sync, APNs push and Sign in with Apple need a paid Apple Developer account, and App Groups (data widgets, share-extension hand-off) are available only when the sideloading tool registers one, so Nib uses them as a progressive enhancement; Goodnotes Cloud, public web links, Email-to-Goodnotes, the Marketplace store, accounts/plans/credits, education admin/roster servers and publisher DRM need Goodnotes' servers. Nib's substitutes: a user-chosen library folder in any Files provider (iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, Google Drive) with conflict-free per-device files, WebDAV, local-network/relay live collaboration, local notifications, a free plugin/content gallery from JSON indexes, and bring-your-own AI.
